description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ainok Survivalist, adding {C}{C}.
Ainok Survivalist dies, triggering Yedora, returning Ainok Survivalist to the battlefield face down as a Forest land with no other types or abilities.
Activate Ainok Survivalist by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ainok Survivalist's megamorph ability by paying {1}{G}, turning it face up with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Ainok Survivalist triggers, destroying target artifact or enchantment an opponent controls.
Repeat.
